contract.job: Check whether increased raw supply headroom can support pre-emptive relay muting without a new audio shunt.

transformer.procurement: Reference comparison only; no exact Chinese in-stock source verified.

contract.additional_load_basis: 20mA additional positive raw allowance for rail-reference/control additions, on top of existing audio/logic/coil profiles and regulator divider loads; not a completed current budget.
limitations: 18V transformer regulation12% is typical; equivalent resistance is not measured DCR and voltage factors are sensitivity assumptions, not guaranteed winding tolerance.

Regulator outputs calculated from datasheet reference range and declared resistor/adjust-current allocation, with3V input-output reserve. Regulator dynamics, thermal regulation, protection discharge and stability are not modeled.
No optocoupler, AC-loss detector or actual contact time is implemented;10/20/30ms are hypothetical total suppression intervals.
1000uF native versus4700/6800 candidate reservoirs compared at minus20% capacitance only.50V exact capacitor ESR/ripple/inrush/body/lead and China purchase evidence still required.
The constant-current load after rail dropout is not physical. Only time to first loss of documented headroom is used.
0..125C regulator range does not qualify operation below0C. Existing cold-coil budget is retained as an independent conservative load.
No native schematic/PCB change, socket exception, three-board fit, Shanghai purchase or manufacturing approval.
contract.comparison_scope: Low mains, stress load, all shutdown phases and .95/1 winding factors; high mains/idle and stress at1.05. 6800uF only.
